了.name: Finish
了.meaning: A hook dangling down to its end. <kanji>Finish</kanji>ed.
了.reading: Last event of the rodeo, りょう. 終了 is the end; 完了 completion.

承.name: Consent
承.meaning: <radical>Finish</radical>, <radical>three</radical> and <radical>water</radical>. Three nods after you finish: <kanji>consent</kanji>.
承.reading: Nodding through a show, しょう. 承知 is consent; 了承 acknowledgement.

片.name: One Side
片.meaning: Half a tree, split down the middle: <kanji>one side</kanji>.
片.reading: A hen, へん, stands on it. 片付ける is to tidy (かた); 破片 a fragment.

版.name: Edition
版.meaning: <radical>One side</radical> of a board pressed <radical>against</radical> paper. A printing block for each <kanji>edition</kanji>.
版.reading: Press it with your hand, はん. 出版 is publishing.

損.name: Loss
損.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical> of a staff <radical>member</radical> in the till. A <kanji>loss</kanji>.
損.reading: Tracked by sonar, そん. 損 is a loss; 損害 damage.

仏.name: Buddha
仏.reading: Sitting on a boot, ぶつ. 仏教 is Buddhism; 仏 Buddha (ほとけ).

績.name: Achievement
績.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical> and <radical>blame</radical>. Take responsibility for spinning the thread: your <kanji>achievement</kanji>.
績.reading: Store it in a sack of rice, せき. 成績 is results, grades.

築.name: Construct
築.meaning: <radical>Bamboo</radical>, <radical>craft</radical>, something <radical>ordinary</radical> and a <radical>tree</radical>. Ordinary wood and bamboo, crafted: <kanji>construct</kanji>.
築.reading: A chick, ちく, builds a nest. 建築 is architecture.

混.name: Mix
混.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> and <radical>insect</radical>s. They <kanji>mix</kanji> into a crowded pond.
混.reading: Stir with an ice cream cone, こん. 混雑 is congestion; 混ぜる to mix.

永.name: Eternal
永.meaning: A <radical>drop</radical> over <radical>water</radical>. A river keeps flowing: <kanji>eternal</kanji>.
永.reading: Deal an ace, えい, forever. 永遠 is eternity.

刊.name: Publish
刊.meaning: Something <radical>dry</radical> and a <radical>knife</radical>. Carve the dry block to <kanji>publish</kanji>.
刊.reading: A kangaroo, かん, delivers it. 朝刊 is the morning paper.

像.name: Statue
像.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> next to an <radical>elephant</radical>. A <kanji>statue</kanji> of both.
像.reading: An elephant, ぞう, of course. 想像 is imagination; 映像 an image.

複.name: Duplicate
複.meaning: <radical>Clothes</radical> with a <radical>gun</radical>, the <radical>sun</radical> and <radical>winter</radical>. Layers on layers: <kanji>duplicate</kanji>.
複.reading: Hang them on a hook, ふく. 複雑 is complicated.

燃.name: Burn
燃.reading: A nun, ねん, runs away. 燃える is to burn; 燃料 fuel.

預.name: Deposit
預.meaning: <radical>In advance</radical> over a <radical>head</radical>. Think ahead and <kanji>deposit</kanji> it.
預.reading: Deposit a yo-yo, よ. 預金 is a deposit; 預ける to entrust.

群.name: Flock
群.meaning: <radical>You</radical> and a <radical>sheep</radical>. You and your sheep: a <kanji>flock</kanji>.
群.reading: Guarded by goons, ぐん. 群れ is a flock (むれ).

快.name: Pleasant
快.reading: Fly a kite, かい. 快適 is comfortable.

液.name: Liquid
液.reading: An eccentric inventor, えき, mixes it. 液体 is liquid.

鉱.name: Mineral
鉱.reading: Mined by a koala, こう. 鉱山 is a mine.

枝.name: Branch
枝.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> and <radical>support</radical>. The part that supports leaves: a <kanji>branch</kanji>.
枝.reading: A sheep, し, nibbles it. 枝 is えだ.

綿.name: Cotton
綿.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical>, <radical>white</radical> and a <radical>towel</radical>. White thread for towels: <kanji>cotton</kanji>.
綿.reading: Soft as ramen noodles, めん. 木綿 is cotton (もめん).

銅.name: Copper
銅.meaning: <radical>Gold</radical> and the <radical>same</radical>. Looks the same as gold but it's <kanji>copper</kanji>.
銅.reading: A copper donut, どう. 銅メダル is a bronze medal.

耕.name: Plow
耕.meaning: A <radical>plow</radical> and a <radical>well</radical>. <kanji>Plow</kanji> the fields around the well.
耕.reading: A koala, こう, pulls it. 耕す is to till.

党.name: Party
党.meaning: <radical>Esteem</radical> over an <radical>older brother</radical>. He's the respected leader of the political <kanji>party</kanji>.
党.reading: Its mascot is a toad, とう. 政党 is a political party.

革.name: Leather
革.meaning: A <radical>cross</radical> with a <radical>mouth</radical>: an animal hide pinned out to dry. <kanji>Leather</kanji>. Tanning changes it completely, so it also means reform.
革.reading: A cackling witch, かく, tans it. 改革 is reform; 革 leather (かわ).

補.name: Supplement
補.meaning: <radical>Clothes</radical> you <radical>use</radical> a <radical>drop</radical> of thread on. Patch them: <kanji>supplement</kanji>.
補.reading: Patch the hose, ほ, too. 補う is to make up for; 候補 a candidate.

域.name: Region
域.meaning: <radical>Dirt</radical>, a <radical>halberd</radical>, a <radical>mouth</radical> and the <radical>ground</radical>. Guarded land: a <kanji>region</kanji>.
域.reading: Covered in icky slime, いき. 地域 is a region.

担.name: Carry
担.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical> at <radical>dawn</radical>. Pick it up at dawn and <kanji>carry</kanji> it all day.
担.reading: Carry it in a tank, たん. 担当 is being in charge; 負担 burden.

脳.name: Brain
脳.meaning: <radical>Moon</radical> (flesh), <radical>sparkle</radical> and <radical>evil</radical>. The sparkly, scheming organ: the <kanji>brain</kanji>.
脳.reading: Keep it in a notebook, のう. 脳 is the brain.

蔵.name: Storehouse
蔵.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical>, a <radical>cliff</radical>, a <radical>halberd</radical> and a <radical>retainer</radical>. A retainer guards the <kanji>storehouse</kanji>.
蔵.reading: Big as an elephant, ぞう. 冷蔵庫 is a fridge; 蔵 a storehouse (くら).

針.name: Needle
針.meaning: <radical>Gold</radical> and a <radical>cross</radical>. A thin metal cross: a <kanji>needle</kanji>.
針.reading: Stuck in your shin, しん. 針 is はり; 方針 a policy.

専.name: Specialty
専.meaning: A <radical>reason</radical> <radical>glue</radical>d to you. Your one thing: your <kanji>specialty</kanji>.
専.reading: Worth every cent, せん. 専門 is speciality.

並.name: Line Up
並.meaning: <radical>Eight</radical>, the <radical>ground</radical> and <radical>business</radical>. Everyone stands shoulder to shoulder: <kanji>line up</kanji>.
並.reading: ならぶ: "narrow boo"th, so you line up. 並ぶ is to line up. へい in compounds.

将.name: Commander
将.meaning: A <radical>bed</radical>, a <radical>claw</radical> and <radical>glue</radical>. He sleeps in his armour: the <kanji>commander</kanji>.
将.reading: He runs the show, しょう. 将来 is the future.

装.name: Attire
装.reading: Decorated with a soda can, そう. 服装 is clothing; 装置 a device.

諸.name: Various
諸.meaning: <radical>Say</radical> to <radical>someone</radical>, and then someone else. <kanji>Various</kanji> people.
諸.reading: Each gets a shovel, しょ. 諸国 is various countries.

劇.name: Drama
劇.meaning: A <radical>tiger</radical>, a <radical>pig</radical> and a <radical>knife</radical>. A tiger fights a pig with a knife: <kanji>drama</kanji>!
劇.reading: Written by a geek, げき. 演劇 is theatre.

署.name: Government Office
署.meaning: A <radical>net</radical> over <radical>someone</radical>. The police station nets people: a <kanji>government office</kanji>.
署.reading: Sign it with a shovel, しょ. 警察署 is a police station; 署名 signature.

延.name: Extend
延.reading: For one more yen, えん. 延期 is postponement; 延びる to be extended.

乱.name: Riot
乱.meaning: A <radical>tongue</radical> and a <radical>swan</radical>. Swans hissing with their tongues out: a <kanji>riot</kanji>.
乱.reading: Everyone's a runner, らん. 混乱 is confusion; 乱れる to be disordered.

庁.name: Agency
庁.meaning: A <radical>canopy</radical> over a <radical>street</radical>. The government <kanji>agency</kanji> on the corner.
庁.reading: Stocked with chocolate, ちょう. 県庁 is the prefectural office.

城.name: Castle
城.reading: Guarded by a joker, じょう. 城 is a castle (しろ).

層.name: Layer
層.meaning: A <radical>flag</radical> over <radical>formerly</radical>. Old flags stacked up: <kanji>layer</kanji>s of history.
層.reading: Like crushed soda cans, そう. 高層 is high-rise.

裏.name: Back
裏.meaning: A <radical>village</radical> hidden inside <radical>clothes</radical>. The lining: the <kanji>back</kanji> side.
裏.reading: Hidden behind a reef, り. 裏 is the back (うら).

著.name: Author
著.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical> over <radical>someone</radical>. Someone crowned with laurels: a famous <kanji>author</kanji>.
著.reading: Paid in chocolate, ちょ. 著者 is an author.

誌.name: Magazine
誌.meaning: <radical>Say</radical> what you <radical>will</radical>. Put it in the <kanji>magazine</kanji>.
誌.reading: A sheep, し, on the cover. 雑誌 is a magazine.

宇.name: Eaves
宇.meaning: <radical>Two</radical> and a <radical>barb</radical> under a <radical>roof</radical>. The edge of the roof: <kanji>eaves</kanji>. Stretch it far enough and it's the universe.
宇.reading: An owl hoots "う" up there. 宇宙 is the universe.

枚.name: Sheet
枚.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> and a <radical>whip</radical>. Beat wood flat into a <kanji>sheet</kanji>. It counts flat things.
枚.reading: Hand them to a microphone, まい. 一枚 is one sheet.

郵.name: Mail
郵.meaning: <radical>Droop</radical> and a <radical>town</radical>. The saggy bag carried from town to town: <kanji>mail</kanji>.
郵.reading: Delivered by ukulele player, ゆう. 郵便 is mail.

骨.name: Bone
骨.reading: Rest it on a cot, こつ. 骨 is ほね; 骨折 a fracture.

届.name: Deliver
届.meaning: A <radical>flag</radical> over a <radical>reason</radical>. Flag them down to <kanji>deliver</kanji> it.
届.reading: とどく: "toe-dock", it reaches the dock on tiptoe. 届く is to arrive; 届ける to deliver.

巻.name: Scroll
巻.meaning: <radical>Two</radical>, <radical>big</radical> and <radical>oneself</radical>. Roll yourself up big: a <kanji>scroll</kanji>.
巻.reading: A kangaroo, かん, unrolls it. 巻く is to roll (まく).

簡.name: Simple
簡.meaning: <radical>Bamboo</radical> with an <radical>interval</radical>. Just a few strips with gaps: <kanji>simple</kanji>.
簡.reading: A kangaroo, かん, could do it. 簡単 is simple.

臓.name: Organ
臓.meaning: <radical>Moon</radical> (flesh) and a <radical>storehouse</radical>. The body's storehouse: an <kanji>organ</kanji>.
臓.reading: An elephant, ぞう, has big ones. 心臓 is the heart.

律.name: Law
律.meaning: <radical>Going</radical> with a <radical>brush</radical>. Write it down as you go: <kanji>law</kanji>.
律.reading: Eat a Ritz cracker, りつ, in rhythm. 法律 is law.

純.name: Pure
純.reading: Worn every June, じゅん. 単純 is simple.

翌.name: Next
翌.meaning: <radical>Feathers</radical> over <radical>stand</radical>. The bird stands up the <kanji>next</kanji> morning.
翌.reading: Eats an egg yolk, よく. 翌日 is the next day.

敬.name: Respect
敬.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical>, a <radical>phrase</radical> and a <radical>whip</radical>. Speak carefully or get whipped: <kanji>respect</kanji>.
敬.reading: Serve cake, けい, to elders. 敬語 is honorific language.

宝.name: Treasure
宝.reading: Spray it with a hose, ほう, to clean it. 宝石 is a gem; 宝 treasure (たから).

胸.name: Chest
胸.meaning: <radical>Moon</radical> (flesh) <radical>wrap</radical>ping something <radical>evil</radical>. Your ribs wrap the dark secrets in your <kanji>chest</kanji>.
胸.reading: In Kyoto, きょう, you puff it out. 胸 is むね.

砂.name: Sand
砂.meaning: <radical>Stone</radical> and <radical>few</radical>. Stone broken into tiny bits: <kanji>sand</kanji>.
砂.reading: Cut it with a saw, さ. 砂漠 is a desert; 砂 sand (すな).

尊.name: Revere
尊.meaning: <radical>Eight</radical>, a <radical>sake</radical> jar and <radical>glue</radical>. Offer sake with both hands: <kanji>revere</kanji>.
尊.reading: Found by sonar, そん. 尊敬 is respect.

幼.name: Infancy
幼.meaning: A <radical>cocoon</radical> with a little <radical>power</radical>. Just starting out: <kanji>infancy</kanji>.
幼.reading: Plays with a yo-yo, よう. 幼稚園 is kindergarten; 幼い very young.

捨.name: Throw Away
捨.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical> and a <radical>cottage</radical>. Clean out the cottage: <kanji>throw away</kanji>.
捨.reading: Feed it to a shark, しゃ. 捨てる is to throw away.

乳.name: Milk
乳.meaning: A <radical>claw</radical>, a <radical>child</radical> and a <radical>swan</radical>. A baby reaching for <kanji>milk</kanji>.
乳.reading: A newt, にゅう, drinks some. 牛乳 is milk.

紅.name: Crimson
紅.reading: A koala, こう, in red. 紅茶 is black tea; 口紅 lipstick.

卵.name: Egg
卵.meaning: A <radical>rabbit</radical> with <radical>drop</radical>s inside. Two halves with yolks: an <kanji>egg</kanji>.
卵.reading: Carried by a runner, らん. 卵 is たまご.

拝.name: Worship
拝.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical> together on a <radical>stick</radical> with <radical>three</radical> lines. Hands pressed together: <kanji>worship</kanji>.
拝.reading: Then a high five, はい. 拝見 is humbly looking.

棒.name: Stick
棒.reading: Shoot it with a bow and arrow, ぼう. 泥棒 is a thief.

蒸.name: Steam
蒸.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical>, <radical>finish</radical>, <radical>water</radical> and <radical>fire</radical>. Put veg in water over fire until finished: <kanji>steam</kanji>.
蒸.reading: Watch the joker, じょう, sweat. 蒸気 is steam; 蒸す to steam.

詞.name: Part of Speech
詞.meaning: <radical>Say</radical> and <radical>director</radical>. The director of language: <kanji>part of speech</kanji>.
詞.reading: A sheep, し, conjugates. 名詞 is a noun; 動詞 a verb.

机.name: Desk
机.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> and a <radical>table</radical>. A wooden table: <kanji>desk</kanji>.
机.reading: Locked with a key, き. 机 is つくえ.

欧.name: Europe
欧.meaning: A <radical>ward</radical> and a <radical>yawn</radical>. Tourists yawning in the old quarters of <kanji>Europe</kanji>.
欧.reading: "Ow!" おう, the cobblestones hurt. 欧米 is the West.

被.name: Suffer
被.meaning: <radical>Clothes</radical> and <radical>skin</radical>. Covering your skin to <kanji>suffer</kanji> the blow.
被.reading: Right on your heel, ひ. 被害 is damage.

含.name: Include
含.meaning: <radical>Now</radical> over a <radical>mouth</radical>. Hold it in your mouth now: <kanji>include</kanji>.
含.reading: ふくむ: "fuku moo", a cow with its mouth full. 含む is to include.

況.name: Condition
況.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> and your <radical>older brother</radical>. He's in hot water: what's his <kanji>condition</kanji>?

湾.name: Bay
湾.meaning: <radical>Water</radical>, a <radical>top hat</radical>, a <radical>bow</radical> and a <radical>barb</radical>. Water curved like a bow: a <kanji>bay</kanji>.
湾.reading: Wave a wand, わん. 東京湾 is Tokyo Bay; 台湾 Taiwan.

捜.name: Search
捜.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical> and a <radical>stool</radical>, with lightning (<radical>say</radical>). Search under everything: <kanji>search</kanji>.
捜.reading: Found a soda can, そう. 捜査 is a criminal investigation.

召.name: Summon
召.meaning: A <radical>sword</radical> over a <radical>mouth</radical>. Draw it and shout: <kanji>summon</kanji> the troops.
召.reading: For the show, しょう. 召し上がる is to eat (honorific).

超.name: Super
超.meaning: <radical>Run</radical> and <radical>summon</radical>. Run past the summons: <kanji>super</kanji> fast.
超.reading: Fuelled by chocolate, ちょう. 超 is super; 超える to exceed.

療.name: Heal
療.meaning: <radical>Sick</radical>, and <radical>big</radical>, <radical>sun</radical> and <radical>small</radical>. Rest in the sun: <kanji>heal</kanji>.
療.reading: After the rodeo, りょう. 治療 is treatment.

介.name: Mediate
介.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> between a <radical>stick</radical> and a <radical>slide</radical>. Stuck between two sides: <kanji>mediate</kanji>.
介.reading: Over a kite, かい. 紹介 is an introduction.

販.name: Sell
販.meaning: A <radical>shell</radical> and <radical>against</radical>. Trade goods against money: <kanji>sell</kanji>.
販.reading: By hand, はん. 販売 is sales; 自販機 a vending machine.

幅.name: Width
幅.meaning: A <radical>towel</radical> next to a <radical>mouth</radical> over a <radical>rice paddy</radical>. Measure the towel's <kanji>width</kanji>.
幅.reading: Hang it on a hook, ふく. 幅 is width (はば).

般.name: General
般.meaning: A <radical>boat</radical> and a <radical>weapon</radical>. The <kanji>general</kanji> carries weapons on the boat.
般.reading: Waves his hand, はん. 一般 is general, ordinary.

換.name: Exchange
換.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical>, a <radical>hook</radical>, a <radical>helmet</radical>, <radical>legs</radical> and something <radical>big</radical>. Hand over the big thing: <kanji>exchange</kanji>.
換.reading: With a kangaroo, かん. 交換 is exchange.

占.name: Fortune
占.meaning: A <radical>toe</radical> over a <radical>mouth</radical>. The oracle's mouth tells your <kanji>fortune</kanji>.
占.reading: For one cent, せん. 占う is to tell fortunes; 独占 monopoly.

伸.name: Stretch
伸.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> and lightning (<radical>say</radical>). Struck by lightning, they <kanji>stretch</kanji> out tall.
伸.reading: のびる: "no, be still!" they can't stop growing. 伸びる is to stretch. しん in compounds.

爆.name: Explode
爆.reading: In your backpack, ばく. 爆発 is an explosion.

普.name: Universal
普.meaning: <radical>Line up</radical> under the <radical>sun</radical>. Everyone gets the same sun: <kanji>universal</kanji>.

齢.name: Age
齢.meaning: <radical>Tooth</radical> and <radical>order</radical>. Count the teeth to tell its <kanji>age</kanji>.
齢.reading: With a ray gun, れい. 年齢 is age.

患.name: Afflicted
患.reading: A kangaroo, かん, takes you to hospital. 患者 is a patient.
